idata.python:
# Define the chord progressions for each guitar
guitar1 = [64, 67, 71]  # E minor colour
guitar2 = [62, 67, 71]  # G major
guitar3 = [60, 64, 67]  # C major
guitar4 = [62, 67, 71]  # G major

# Define musical timing variables
opening_rest = 1
note_duration = 0.4
rest_duration = 1.6

# Organise guitar chords into a progression
guitar_progression = [
    guitar1, guitar1,
    guitar2, guitar2,
    guitar3, guitar3,
    guitar4, guitar4 ]

# Create a function to play each guitar chord
def play_guitar_chord(chord):
    playNote(chord, beats=note_duration)
    rest(rest_duration)

# Begin the composition
rest(opening_rest)

# Loop through the chord progression
for chord in guitar_progression:
    play_guitar_chord(chord)

# Each 0.4 beat note helps maintain the rhythm and timing
